validation_method: Every lot car with a rule WMI, a 17-character VIN and a valid check digit is classified. The model year comes from VIN character 10 (the listing year only picks the 30-year cycle and must be within 2 years). A rule fires only when the VIN matches its WMI, years and fixed characters and character 8 is in its table for that year; other codes get no claim. Ground truth = scraper/manual_detect/ground_truth.jsonl; uniformCell lines are unlabelled, speeds-only lines excluded, the rest checkable: agree means (truth is manual) == (rule says manual). Ford/Lincoln/Mercury ground truth is almost all vPIC decodes of MY2017+ cars (vPIC gives no Ford transmission before then) plus VIN-less listing lines, so no rule here has a checkable car. Independent checks: (1) epa_rows, the EPA rows for the rule's exact model/engine (row ids, all must be the claimed class); (2) a per-car EPA union check (year/make/model names + vPIC displacement) as in vin_rules_1. Status: candidate (not counted) when the transmission evidence is contradicted or EPA-only; drop when >= 20 checkable and agreement < 0.995; low_sample when < 20 checkable (kept: code meaning from Ford's own filing, manual-only fact from EPA plus an independent text source); keep otherwise. newly_confirmed_manual counts lot cars with no published transmission (vehicle_extras trans empty) that a keep or low_sample rule calls manual.
